project_type: Monorepo: Spring Boot (Kotlin) mock API backend + 3 Next.js frontends (admin/partner/mobile)
build_system: Gradle Kotlin DSL (backend, wrapper at api/runNshop-api/gradlew); npm (each FE app has its own package.json, no root workspace)
test_framework: None configured for backend (no src/test dir) or FE (no test runner in package.json). Verification = build + curl + manual response inspection (existing project convention).
build_command: Backend: `./gradlew clean build -x test` with cwd=api/runNshop-api. FE: `npm run build` with cwd=apps/runNshop-{admin|partner|mobile} (each app's package.json script is `next build`).
test_command: No automated test command exists. Runtime verification = `./gradlew bootRun` (port 8080) then curl each changed endpoint and confirm `"code":"SUCCESS"` (NOT `NOT_FOUND`, which signals a wrong mock path), then stop the server.
verification_instructions: FEAT-001 (backend): 1) `cd api/runNshop-api && ./gradlew clean build -x test` must succeed. 2) `./gradlew bootRun` in background, port 8080, curl every endpoint listed in that FEAT's verification list, confirm `code:SUCCESS` on every one (catches mock-path-wrong NOT_FOUND), then kill the bootRun process. FEAT-002 (frontend+docs): depends on FEAT-001's new URLs being live in code (not necessarily running) — `npm run build` for admin/partner/mobile must all succeed. No runtime curl needed for FEAT-002 since it only touches FE call strings + prefix + doc prose.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in from build (Next.js .next/ and Gradle build/ are gitignored). No generated files need to be committed.
environment_constraints: node_modules already installed for all 3 FE apps. gradlew is executable. Backend server runs on port 8080. apps/mobile_c and apps/admin_c are STRAY duplicate scaffolding directories (confirmed via a prior unrelated task's context.json) containing their own /api/v1/ fetch() calls — DO NOT TOUCH, out of scope. apps/runNshop-admin/src/system/program-status/mockData.ts has an unrelated `/api/v1/settlement` string inside sample monitoring/log display data (not a real route) — DO NOT TOUCH. Work-scope steering restricts direct edits to Order domain docs; Payment/Catalog/Promotion/Member DOCS are read-only reference EXCEPT the two explicit targets named in the user's spec (DL-인터페이스명세/payment.md Path text only, and backend code files in catalog/member/promotion packages which the user explicitly listed as code-change targets) — if genuinely new edits beyond the named spec items are needed in those domains, stop and ask the user first; the spec itself is the user's explicit go-ahead for the listed files.
contribution_requirements: api-design-rules.md (steering, authoritative, do not re-debate): URL prefix /api/{channel}/{version}/{resource}, channel before version, channels admin/partner/mobile, mobile prefix is /api/mobile/v1/**. No domain name in any URL. mobile 'owned-by-me' resources get /my/{resource} (orders, claims, cart, payment-methods, payments, summary); public catalog-type resources (products, exhibitions, display pages) do NOT get /my. mock-data-rules.md (steering, authoritative): mock file path is mock/{domain}/{channel}__{METHOD}_{API_PATH}.json — folder=domain, filename-prefix=channel (reversed from old mock/{channel}/{domain}__... layout). API_PATH drops the /api/{channel}/{version} prefix but KEEPS /my if present. Path params in filenames are snake_case regardless of the real camelCase param name. coding-standards.md: no FE hardcoding, all data via backend API. This is a NAMING/PATH-ONLY refactor per the user's explicit spec — do not change business logic, response body schemas, Mock JSON data contents, or Controller/Service class structure (only URL string literals and the 2 mockLoader.load() args change).
key_patterns: Backend Controller pattern (unchanged structurally): @RestController (+ optional @RequestMapping prefix) with constructor-injected MockLoader (or MockLoader + a Service like OrderController/OrderService), @GetMapping/@PostMapping handlers calling mockLoader.load(channel, filename) and returning ResponseEntity.ok(data). MockLoader.load(channel, filename) resolves classpath resource at `mock/$channel/$filename` TODAY (first arg is a path segment it does NOT change its own code for this task — the task repurposes the semantic meaning of the two string arguments the CALLERS pass, it does not touch MockLoader.kt's internal path-join logic, which still does mock/$channel/$filename — so passing channel='order' and filename='admin__GET_orders.json' naturally resolves to the new mock/order/admin__GET_orders.json path with ZERO code changes to MockLoader.kt itself, only a comment update). OrderService.kt already centralizes admin/partner/mobile order list+detail logic behind getAdminOrders/getPartnerOrders/getMyOrders/get*OrderDetail methods — none of those method names or signatures change, only the string literals passed to mockLoader.load() inside them. FE lib/api.ts pattern: `const PREFIX = '...'; export async function api<T>(path): Promise<T> { fetch(`${API_BASE}${PREFIX}${path}`)... }` — mobile/lib/api.ts is the only one whose PREFIX changes. FE pages call `api<T>('/some/path')` with the PREFIX-relative path baked in at each call site (not centralized), so each of the 7 'owned' mobile pages needs its literal path string edited individually.
